settings-platform-mode.title: Settings: Platform Mode + Shizuku Status
settings-platform-mode.description: Surface PlatformMode toggle and Shizuku status in Settings. Add effective-mode signal so UI reflects runtime, not just persisted intent.

spm-shizuku-permission-listener.title: ShizukuClient permission-result listener wrappers
spm-shizuku-permission-listener.description: Add addRequestPermissionResultListener/removeRequestPermissionResultListener wrappers to ShizukuClient and ShizukuRuntimeGateway so UI never calls Shizuku.* directly.
acceptCriteria: addRequestPermissionResultListener and removeRequestPermissionResultListener exist on ShizukuClient
Methods proxy to Shizuku.* via ShizukuRuntimeGateway

spm-effective-platform-mode-signal.title: AgentService.effectivePlatformMode StateFlow
spm-effective-platform-mode-signal.description: Expose StateFlow<PlatformMode?> in AgentService set from constructed AndroidPlatform.mode on session start. Collected into MainActivityContent. Null until first session.
acceptCriteria: Set from AndroidPlatform.mode in observeExternalSession path
MainActivityContent collects it as Compose state

spm-shizuku-status-observer.title: rememberShizukuStatus produceState observer
spm-shizuku-status-observer.description: Sealed class ShizukuStatus = Unavailable|NeedsPermission|Ready. produceState reads only on init, ON_RESUME, permission-result, binder-dead. Single DisposableEffect registers/unregisters both listeners via ShizukuClient wrappers.
acceptCriteria: No Shizuku.* imports in either file
Both listeners registered AND unregistered in one DisposableEffect

spm-display-mode-section.title: DisplayModeSection composable
spm-display-mode-section.description: 2-option selector + Shizuku status row. Selector visual = effectivePlatformMode ?: persistedPlatformMode. Virtual Display option disabled iff status != Ready. Grant calls ShizukuClient.requestPermission; Learn more opens shizuku.rikka.app via Intent.ACTION_VIEW.
acceptCriteria: VD option disabled state binds to ShizukuStatus

spm-wire-permissions-page.title: Wire DisplayModeSection into Settings + Home subtitle
spm-wire-permissions-page.description: Insert DisplayModeSection between Permissions and Debug. Home subtitle shows mode chip iff effectivePlatformMode != null. Intent path via MainActivityIntentApplier still works. No Shizuku flow plumbed from Activity.
acceptCriteria: DisplayModeSection rendered between Permissions and Debug
Home subtitle includes mode chip only when effectivePlatformMode != null
MainActivityIntentApplier intent path still calls updatePlatformMode

spm-qa-coverage.title: Instrumented tests for DisplayMode UI
spm-qa-coverage.description: QA test asserts (a) toggling selector calls updatePlatformMode; (b) VD option disabled when status is Unavailable; (c) Home subtitle reflects effectivePlatformMode and is omitted when null.
acceptCriteria: New test class covers all three assertions
